chapter.v:
Praise the
Lord! Praise the Lord's reputation! Praise the Lord, all you servants of the Lord

who worship
in the house of the Lord, in the courts of our God.

Praise the
Lord, for the Lord is good; sing praises to his character because it is wonderful!

For the
Lord has chosen Jacob for himself; Israel as his very own.

I know
how great the Lord is—our Lord is greater than all gods.

The Lord
does whatever he wants throughout heaven and earth, on the seas and in the ocean depths.

He causes
the clouds to rise all over the earth, he makes lightning flash and give rain, he sends the winds from his storehouses.

He struck
down the firstborn of Egypt, both human and animal.

He did
wonderful miracles among you in Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

He struck
down many nations, he killed powerful kings, such as

Sihon, king
of the Amorites, Og, king of Bashan, and all the kings who ruled in Canaan.

He handed
over their lands to Israel, his special people, for them to possess.

Your reputation,
Lord, stands forever; you, Lord, are remembered for all generations.

The Lord
will vindicate his people; he will show compassion to those who follow him.

The idols
of the foreign nations are only objects of silver and gold, made by human hands.

They have
mouths, but can't speak; they have eyes, but can't see.

They have
ears, but can't hear; they can't even breathe!

Those who
make idols will become just like them, and so will everyone who trusts in them.

People of
Israel, praise the Lord! Descendants of Aaron, praise the Lord!

Levites, praise
the Lord! Everyone who worships the Lord, praise the Lord!

Praise the
Lord from Zion, for he lives in Jerusalem! Praise the Lord!
